component: News delivery callback and compose progress

quotes.text: await this._msgSend.sendDeliveryCallback(url, exitCode, null, null, true);

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The sender awaits _deliverAsNews, which waits for a dedicated listener promise. OnStopRunningUrl awaits delivery processing before resolving or rejecting by status. A callback rejection would bypass those later settlement statements; it was not exercised here. Native send failure closes progress without doing the success-only FCC lookup. The changed mock reports immediate success only, and its existing assertions inspect file/account selection rather than the failure dialog. Later QA success is historical evidence, not a new run.
title: NNTP delivery waits for its callback before the send promise settles
